mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.name,c.code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_channel uc WHERE uc.channel_id=c.id) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.channel_id=c.id) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pc.product_id) FROM listing l JOIN sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id JOIN product_color pc ON pc.id=s.color_id JOIN product p ON p.id=pc.product_id WHERE l.channel_id=c.id AND pc.deleted=0 AND p.deleted=0) AS productCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM listing l JOIN sku s ON s.id=l.sku_id JOIN product_color pc ON pc.id=s.color_id JOIN product p ON p.id=pc.product_id WHERE l.channel_id=c.id AND pc.deleted=0 AND p.deleted=0 AND l.on_sale=1) AS onSaleCount FROM channel c ORDER BY c.id
